output.revised_prompt: Create a stylized-concept asset: a wide horizontal mobile slot-game jackpot animation overlay intended for chroma-key extraction. STRICT COMPOSITION: low, wide 3:2 landscape canvas and banner silhouette, substantially wider than tall. Exactly one medium circular deep-burgundy medallion centered precisely in the composition; medallion diameter no more than 55% of total artwork width. Long, elegant, layered champagne-gold wings extend dramatically and symmetrically to both sides, with wingtip-to-wingtip width at least 1.8 times the total artwork height. Add a compact, low-profile crown crest directly above the circle, never tall or vertically dominant. Surround the medallion with luminous white pearls, refined champagne-gold filigree, and small embedded ruby, emerald, and diamond accents. Premium high-end 3D casino-game art, polished metal, realistic pearl luster, convincing gemstone refraction, soft luxurious mood, rich but restrained and not gaudy. Entire ornament centered, fully visible, uncropped, with generous clear margins on all sides. Background must be perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta #FF00FF for chroma keying. Absolutely no gradients, texture, vignette, cast shadow, reflection, ambient spill, or background glow on the magenta. No magenta anywhere within the artwork itself. No letters, words, numbers, slot-reel symbols, standalone coin icons, characters, rectangular cards, logos, or watermarks. Ensure clean isolated edges and strong separation from background.
